title: Lot
description: One open FIFO lot. DERIVED, NEVER STORED. Lots run alongside weighted-average cost: the average is what the UI displays, the lots are what tax computation needs. Source of truth: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 3.

open_date.description: The acquiring transaction's trade date. Holding period is measured from here.

quantity_open.description: Remaining unconsumed quantity. A sell smaller than the oldest lot splits that lot rather than consuming it.

cost_per_unit.description: BONUS and SPLIT_ADJ push a lot at cost 0, dated the corporate-action date. That is what makes bonus-stripping rules computable in a later phase.
